name: Press Kit Editorial
tagline: A complete 24-page editorial press kit with Manrope typography, alphabetical index, thin rules, native fact sheets and independent photographs.

palette.description: Source charcoal and white with hairline grey rules; warm neutral photographic colors stay within independent image frames.

best_for: Brand press kits, media information packs, lifestyle company introductions and premium editorial stories with factual reference lists, product photography and downloadable-asset directories.
avoid_for: Dense financial dashboards or decks without strong photography. Pure-image pacing pages do not add capacity for long body text. Source-aligned small editorial text requires a presentation-size display.

typography.style: Manrope variable TTF 4.505, weights 200/300/400/500/700. This distribution replaces the source Cabinet Grotesk because its redistribution terms do not permit the bundled template use. Per-weight CSS size-adjust and ascent/descent/line-gap calibration preserve source frame geometry, baseline rhythm and near-matching text widths; glyph outlines differ. Original palette,1920×1080 grid and independent media remain. The original demo quote on page 11 is shortened to preserve the source quote frame and wrapping capacity with Manrope; source CSS sizes and line heights remain.

source_inspiration.name: Isaac Powell — Press Kit (Pitch), 24 public slides
source_inspiration.notes: Complete 24-page native HTML/CSS/SVG source-inspired reconstruction. Original1920×1080 frame geometry, palette, independent image crops and page order are preserved; long demo copy is original fictional content. Typography is explicitly adapted: Manrope variable TTF 4.505, weights 200/300/400/500/700. This distribution replaces the source Cabinet Grotesk because its redistribution terms do not permit the bundled template use. Per-weight CSS size-adjust and ascent/descent/line-gap calibration preserve source frame geometry, baseline rhythm and near-matching text widths; glyph outlines differ. Original palette,1920×1080 grid and independent media remain. Source SVG ornaments remain independent native elements; no full-slide screenshot or source platform runtime is used. Source artwork and media retain original rights; font substitution does not establish their separate standalone template distribution clearance. The original demo quote on page 11 is shortened to preserve the source quote frame and wrapping capacity with Manrope; source CSS sizes and line heights remain.
